title: LLM Ethics Benchmark: A Three-Dimensional Assessment System for Evaluating Moral Reasoning in Large Language Models
findings: All tested models showed lower alignment with 'binding' moral foundations (which include Loyalty, Authority, and Sanctity) compared to 'individualizing' foundations (Care and Fairness). This indicates a weaker grasp of moral intuitions related to concepts like divinity and sacredness, which are often tied to religious or traditional group cohesion.
